prompt: Award-winning luxury fashion campaign photography for Monavi Collection ("Wear Your Story"). Stunning 25-year-old Indian bride model with classic South Asian features, delicate kohl eyeliner, radiant dewy skin, gentle graceful smile, elegant regal poise, wearing premium bespoke Lehenga crafted from rich Velvet Silk, Raw Silk with Dabka, Georgette with Mukaish, Tulle in shades of Deep Crimson, Rich Burgundy, Rose Gold. Intricate tailoring, pristine seam lines, tactile fabric weave, authentic drapery and natural folds. Setting: Regal Indian heritage palace courtyard, subtle jharokha arches, warm ambient lantern glow. Lighting: Cinematic warm amber lighting, golden hour highlights catching metallic zari embroidery. Camera: Shot on Hasselblad H6D-100c medium format, 85mm f/1.4 lens, shallow depth of field, authentic filmic color rendition. Skin & Anatomy: Natural human skin pores, fine skin texture, anatomically perfect hands and fingers, realistic fabric texture, ultra-high resolution 8k. Composition rule: Model is positioned towards the center-right. The left 40% has smooth cinematic falloff and clean negative space reserved for brand typography. Framing rule: Full-length or three-quarter standing portrait showing the complete ensemble from head to knees and ankles, ensuring BOTH the upper kurta/tunic and lower pajama/churidar/skirt are fully and visibly showcased. Never crop at waist.
